paragraphs: R' Tzadok ben Haluka. ‘I saw R' Yosi ben Zimra, who was old and sat in the academy, obtain permission to permit firstborn animals.’ R' Abba told him: ‘That is not how the incident occurred. Rather, R' Yosi ben Zimra was a priest, and his question was whether the halakhah follows R' Meir: one suspected concerning a matter may neither judge it nor testify about it.’ Yoma 78a:12–13 [Heilprin cites the end of 78b]. See R' Yosi ben Haluka; this needs examination.
